tools.description: Search Amazon.com.br by keyword and return one result page: ASIN, title, BRL price and list price, rating and rating count, Prime badge, sponsored flag and product URL. Pages 1-20; blocked pages raise an error.

Get public Amazon.com.br product details by ASIN or URL: title, brand, BRL price and list price, stock text, buy-box seller and shipper ('Vendido por' / 'Enviado por'), rating summary, images, feature bullets, specifications and variations.

Get the featured buy-box offer for one Amazon.com.br ASIN or product URL: BRL price, list price and discount, stock state and text, seller and shipper, delivery promise and the other-offers summary. Set include_other_offers to also read the first page of other sellers' offers from the public all-offers drawer.

Get the review summary the public Amazon.com.br product page shows: average rating, rating count, the 5-to-1 star histogram and the top reviews on the page (text, stars, date, verified purchase). Paginated review lists need sign-in and are not read.
